payload.text: hv by AskUserQuestion in vc's window, read by 2026-11-27 08:57Z by date -u, hv's choice of vc's recommended option, 'Delete them (Recommended)', on the hand-off of 19 Nov: on gyges and kovacs, each sysadm checks that the old v1 subagent files elixir.md, intent.md and worker-bee.md in ~/.config/claude/agents/ still match their v1 checksums, then deletes them and the old v1 manifest ~/.local/share/intent/agents/installed-agents.json. If auto mode refuses a delete, hv types the lines. gyges-sysadm had already reinstalled diogenes and socrates from Intent 3.5.6's source by 08:57Z. The question whether Intent's uninstall should honour the v1 record goes to Intent as a future, unstarted WP.
